latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — provides beginner-friendly AI-assisted video editing and export via CapCut cloud.

- Edit raw video clips into short, stylized outputs with simple instructions (trims, transitions, music).
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB; delivers 1080p MP4 exports in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic onboarding: uses provided or anonymous API tokens; session managed entirely in background.
- Handles common workflows such as uploads, state/credits checks, export, and file management.
- Short, plain-language feedback throughout; technical processing details are hidden from the user.
- Robust error handling for tokens, session state, file size/type, and rate-limiting.
